text:
10G Media Converter
LT-MC80X (1*10G SFP+ port + 1*10/100M/1G/2.5G/5G/10G RJ45 port）
Overview:
SmartByte LT-MC80X media converter is a 10G N-Base-T (10/100M/1G/2.5G/5G/10G) to 10GBase-R media converter, Which converts traditional twisted-pair RJ-45 cable into SFP+ slot for pluggable fiber transceiver, extending transmission distance to servers, switches and patch panels  for Data Center 10G N-Base-T to 10GBase-R conversion application or ISP Mobile DU and Enterprise broadband service applications.
Picture
Features:
10/100/1G/2.5G/5G/10G BASE-T RJ45 interface with auto MDI/MDI-X function, 10GBASE-X SFP+ slot interface
IEEE 802.3u/802.3ab/802.3bz/802.3ae Ethernet standard compliant
Supports auto-negotiation and 100Mbps half/full duplex and 1/2.5/5/10Gbps full duplex mode
Fan-less design, support plug and play installation
Support watchdog function, which can restart the equipments automatically when it is frozen
Wide range input voltage: DC5-12V
4KV surge protection; ESD: 8KV/contact, 15KV/air protection
Technical specification
PRODUCT PARAMETERS
Ports Interface
Fixed port	1*10G Base-X SFP+ port + 1*10/100/1G/2.5G/5G/10G Base－T RJ45 port
Power interface	DC Jack
Standard	IEEE 802.3u 100BASE-TX
IEEE 802.3ab 1000BASE-T
IEEE 802.3bz 2.5G/5GBASE-T
IEEE 802.3an 10GBASE-T
IEEE 802.3ae 10Gbps Ethernet
IEEE 802.3x full-duplex flow control
LED Indicators
PWR	Power supply indicator	
Fiber Link/Act	Fiber port operation indicator	
SD	Fiber signal detection indicator	
10G	Electrical port speed rate indicator	
Copper Link	Electrical operation state indicator	
Copper Act	Electrical port data receiving/transmission indicator	
Cable type & Transmission distance
Twisted-pair	1000Base-T:  0-100m  Cat5
Twisted-pair	2.5GBase-T:  0-100m  Cat5e
Twisted-pair	5GBase-T:  0-100m  Cat5e
Twisted-pair	10G Base-T:  0-100m  Cat6a
Fiber	50/125μm or 62.5/125μm multi-mode fiber optic cable, up to 300m, 9/125μm single-mode fiber optic cable, up to 60km
Electrical Specifications
Input voltage	DC5-12 V
Total Power consumption	≤4.1W
Layer 2 Switching
Forwarding delay	<5us
MDX/MIDX	Support
Watchdog	Support
Environment
Operating temperature	-20℃~70℃
Storage temperature	-40℃~85℃
Relative humidity	5%~95% （non-condensing）
Thermal methods	Fan-less, natural heat dissipation
MTBF	100,000 hours
Protection & Certification	
Surge protection of Power	IEC 61000-4-5  Level 4（4KV）（8/20us）
Surge protection of Ethernet port	IEC 61000-4-5  Level 3（2KV）（10/700us）
ESD	IEC 61000-4-2  Level 4 （8K/15K）
Free fall	0.5m
Certification	CE, FCC, RoHs
Mechanical Structure
Dimension	95*71*27mm
Installation Method	Desktop, wall-mount
Weight	Net weight 0.2KG
Order information
Model	Description
LT-MC80X	10G media converter with 1*10/100/1G/2.5G/5G/10G RJ45 port + 10G SFP+ slot,  DC5-12V
